text: (Oracle). An oracle is a collection O = {Oλ,n }λ∈N,n∈N where each Oλ,n is a distribution over functions Func(Xλ,n , Yλ,n ) for some finite sets Xλ,n , Yλ,n . We write f ∈ O to denote that f is in the support of Oλ,n for some λ ∈ N, n ∈ N. An oracle O has input size bound ℓin if for every λ, n ∈ N, Xλ,n ⊆ {0, 1}≤ℓin (λ,n) . The empty oracle O⊥ is the oracle whose only function f ∈ O⊥ is the function with empty domain.
